---
title: "E513: rename merges states"
description: "M.rename(f) must map different states to different values."
---

<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

M.rename(f) must map different states to different values.

## Example

```delta error
dfa M {
  alphabet a
  start [0]
  accept [1]
  [0] -a-> [1]
  [1] -a-> [0]
}
let N = M.rename(fn(q) = 0)
```
